title: Understanding Data Manipulation Tools
text: Think about the tools you use when working with small datasets, like those you might handle in a spreadsheet. These tools are often used for data analysis and manipulation in Python.

title: Handling Large Datasets
text: Consider the tools that are designed to process large datasets, often distributed across multiple machines. These tools are commonly used in big data processing and analytics.

title: Versatile Data Tools
text: Some tools are designed to handle both small and large datasets efficiently. They often provide a familiar interface while leveraging the power of distributed computing.
